topography.project_purpose: ChainGPT should be described as ChainGPT Pad, a launchpad/fundraising protocol with associated staking pools. Its topology and contract relationships should be treated as low-confidence unless supported by deployer, factory, event, or source-code evidence; do not assert that all observed or unnamed contracts are native modules tied to a single central ChainGPT contract.
topography.relationship_narrative: All contracts belong to a single product family deployed by two main deployer clusters, indicating a unified launchpad system. The unnamed contracts likely serve as supporting modules or instances for different chains or sale types, all tied to the central ChainGPT contract.
